# ClearGadgetItems <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ClearGadgetItems:Void gadget:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a list box, combo box or tabber. |

## Description

Removes every entry of a list box, combo box or tabber.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Clear", 10, 10, 300, 200, Desktop(), 3)
list = CreateListBox(10, 10, 200, 100, win)
AddGadgetItem list, "One"
AddGadgetItem list, "Two"
ClearGadgetItems list
SetGadgetText win, "Items: " + CountGadgetItems(list)
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
